A340E(Others) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - COMPONENT PARTS REMOVAL

6. REMOVE NO.1 VEHICLE SPEED SENSOR
(a) Remove the No.1 vehicle speed sensor.
(b) Remove the O-ring from it.

Q00623

7. REMOVE NO.2 VEHICLE SPEED SENSOR
(a) Remove the No.2 vehicle speed sensor.
(b) Remove the O-ring from it.

Q00620

8. REMOVE TRANSMISSION HOUSING
(a) Remove the 6 bolts.
(b) Remove the transmission housing.

AT6647

9. INSTALL TRANSMISSION CASE
Install the transmission case on the overhaul attachment.

AT5092

10. REMOVE EXTENSION HOUSING
(a) Remove the 6 bolts.
(b) Remove the extension housing.

Q00607
